$comment: Old Letters sheet: one row of cells in `chars` order, each `cell` px wide and `height` px tall. Glyphs are white on transparent, start at column 0 of their cell, and `widths` gives each one's ink width. Rows 0-1 ascender, 2-6 body, 7 descender. Glyphs from the design system's Old Letters sheet (ART DIRECTION, 2026-10-12). After the letters, one more cell holds the divider (Lore §4.5, ART 2026-10-18): a single dot at mid-height (row 4) between a plot sentence's two words and at both joins of the plot seal's ring. It is not a letter, so it is not in `chars`.
